name: 21046 · Columbia, MD
findings: ZIP 21046 (Columbia) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21046 (Columbia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21046 (Columbia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.6 times the typical level).
